name: sidebar-10
title: Sidebar 10
description: A sidebar with a popover: a notes app with favorites and workspaces on the pad and, in the page header, a star and a "..." that opens a slip of actions built from the same menu parts as the pad. Mirrors shadcn's sidebar-10. Looks right on the desk and on plain paper.

import * as React from "react"

import { notesFavorites, notesNav, notesSecondary, notesWorkspaces, appTeams } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-data"
import { NavSecondary } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-nav-app"
import { NavFavorites, NavLinks, NavWorkspaces } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-nav-notes"
import { TeamSwitcher } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-team-switcher"
import { Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarHeader, SidebarRail } from "@/components/ui/sidebar"

export function AppSidebar({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof Sidebar>) {
  return (
    <Sidebar role="navigation" aria-label="Notes" {...props}>
      <SidebarHeader>
        <TeamSwitcher teams={appTeams} compact />
        <NavLinks items={notesNav} />
      </SidebarHeader>
      <SidebarContent>
        <NavFavorites favorites={notesFavorites} />
        <NavWorkspaces workspaces={notesWorkspaces} />
        <NavSecondary items={notesSecondary} className="mt-auto" />
      </SidebarContent>
      <SidebarRail />
    </Sidebar>
  )
}

import { AppSidebar } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-10/components/sidebar-10-app-sidebar"
import { NavActions } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-10/components/sidebar-10-nav-actions"
import { containedClasses } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-contained"
import { PageBody, PageHeader, PageNote, PageSheet } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-page"
import { SidebarProvider } from "@/components/ui/sidebar"

export default function Page({ contained = false }: { contained?: boolean }) {
  const c = containedClasses(contained)
  return (
    <SidebarProvider className={c.provider}>
      <AppSidebar className={c.sidebar} />
      <PageSheet className={c.inset}>
        <PageHeader crumbs={["Project plan & to-dos"]}>
          <NavActions />
        </PageHeader>
        <PageBody title="Project plan & to-dos" kicker="Favorites">
          <PageNote title="A blank page, for now" pose="write">
            Nothing on this page yet. Open the three dots up in the corner to see what you can do with it.
          </PageNote>
        </PageBody>
      </PageSheet>
    </SidebarProvider>
  )
}
